title: Guide audience and limitations
summary: Frames the guide as a learning foundation rather than sufficient knowledge for top-level A20 performance, and emphasizes individual evaluation.
anchors: ultimate goal is evaluating every situation individually

title: Deck-role terminology
summary: Defines block, scaling, utility, synergy cards, enablers, and exploiters as a vocabulary for later construction advice.

title: Act 1 construction priorities
summary: Prioritizes enough front-loaded damage for elites before adding utility, then adjusts preparation for the three Act 1 bosses.

title: First boss reward transition
summary: Discusses four energy, rare cards, immediate Act 2 stability, and long-term engine pieces after the Act 1 boss.
anchors: Having 4 energy is a huge benefit

title: Act 2 construction priorities
summary: Adds burst, area damage, stronger defense, scaling, and conditional synergy while preparing for Act 2 elites and bosses.

title: Act 3 construction priorities
summary: Emphasizes scaling, premium block, draw, exhaust support, and aggressive skipping for the boss gauntlet.

title: Act 4 and Heart preparation
summary: Describes the Act 4 elite and Heart requirements for block, scaling, draw, artifact removal, and execution.
anchors: A deck therefore requires plenty of block

title: Conditional examples of Ironclad card roles
summary: Lists notable cards while warning that card value changes with deck, relics, upcoming fights, and infinite potential.
anchors: Card value changes very, very dramatically

title: Trap cards and dependency debt
summary: Explains how synergy-dependent cards and themed decks can dilute access to their own enablers, including Fire Breathing status decks.

title: Consistency and guide limits
summary: Concludes that many winning constructions exist and the guide aims at consistency rather than forcing one archetype.
